fonts.display: 'Monument', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

palette.name: Ice White
palette.role: Primary text and dominant border color — cool blue-tinted white that doubles as hairline borders, card outlines, and link underlines, creating a wireframe-in-light effect across all surfaces

palette.name: Void Black
palette.role: Deepest surface — page canvas and footer base

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Card surface — sits one shade above void, used for elevated content blocks

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Body background and footer border surface — mid-layer charcoal

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Card backgrounds and the most common elevated surface — the default panel

palette.name: Iron
palette.role: Muted body text and subtle dividers — secondary text level

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Tertiary body text and low-emphasis borders

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Helper text and low-contrast borders — the quietest readable neutral

palette.name: Electric Cobalt
palette.role: Violet wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Signal Orange
palette.role: Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color
